newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sweet grades recover late, Apr scheduling on.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sweet grades recover late, Apr scheduling on.

text.p: U.S. sweet crude grades staged a recovery Thursday afternoon after starting the session weak, while outright prices fluctuated wildly on expiration day for April NYMEX futures.
April West Texas Intermediate Cushing closed out the NYMEX session at $22.32, down some 28 cents from Thursday, but aftermarket deals for outright crude declined to $20.93-95.
The Apr/May WTI roll was done at +25 cts in the aftermarket, and was bid at that number late in the afternoon.
Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James was measured at flat to the Apr WTI/Cushing, after starting the session at -15 cts.
